title: HW↔DATA-001: Hardware-Generated Data Formats + Sensor Data Pipeline Requirements (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — there is NO direct §6 contract on either the Hardware Engineer or the Data Engineer side (HARDWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Data Engineer; DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Hardware Engineer). The hardware→data relationship is mediated: raw sensor signals are formatted into telemetry by Firmware (HW↔FW-001) and validated against the DATA-owned schema registry via FW↔DATA-001, while sensor characterization for modeling flows through HW↔ML-001. This schema reconstructs the plausible direct interface (hardware-generated data formats ↔ sensor-data-pipeline ingestion requirements) for machine validation; per its x-macp.source_status it mandates a COUNTER (request §6 ratification via a CCR) rather than a binding CONFIRM. No data ranges, rates, or quality thresholds are invented.

hardware_data_formats.description: HW→DATA: raw sensor output formats and data-generation characteristics.

data_pipeline_requirements.description: DATA→HW: ingestion/schema requirements for hardware-generated data (routed through the DATA-owned registry).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Provisional/DERIVED edge — no §6 contract exists on either side; the real data path is mediated (HW↔FW-001 → FW↔DATA-001 telemetry schema; HW↔ML-001 characterization). Until a §6 contract is ratified, agents coordinate provisionally and must COUNTER for ratification; the authoritative per-field telemetry schema remains DATA-owned.

mediation.rationale: No direct contract needed: hardware does not emit data to the pipeline — Firmware does. Raw sensor signals are formatted into telemetry (HW↔FW-001) and validated against the DATA-owned schema registry via FW↔DATA-001; characterization for modelling flows through HW↔ML-001.

x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisional — to be set by the ratifying §6 contract / CCR)
confirm_conditions: every sensor data-format quantity (resolution, sampling rate) carries an explicit unit
novel hardware-generated data routes through the DATA-owned schema registry (FW↔DATA-001)
the mediated path is declared (HW↔FW-001 / FW↔DATA-001 / HW↔ML-001)
no telemetry field name/unit/range is invented outside the DATA registry
reject_conditions: a sensor resolution or sampling rate emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a hardware-generated telemetry field defined here instead of the DATA-owned registry (schema ownership)
this DERIVED schema treated as a binding contract — it is provisional pending §6 ratification (source_status)
counter_conditions: ALWAYS COUNTER: request ratification of a real HW↔DATA §6 contract (or confirm the relationship is intentionally mediated) via a CCR before any binding CONFIRM
a direct hardware→data flow is proposed that bypasses Firmware formatting — request routing through HW↔FW-001 / FW↔DATA-001
